profile.summary: The developer 'boyaq' has contributed to the Moment.js library primarily by adding new locale configurations (Uyghur) and associated test files. While their contributions demonstrate familiarity with Moment.js internals—particularly its locale system and testing framework (Jest)—there is no direct evidence of core JavaScript development or modern frontend/backend frameworks. Their contributions are limited to localization and test-driven development within a JavaScript library context, suggesting a junior-level proficiency in JavaScript with exposure to testing and library maintenance. No evidence of advanced JavaScript concepts, TypeScript, or modern frameworks (React, Vue, etc.) is present in their contributions.
